name: Pagination
blurb: Page numbers with previous and next links.
mechanism: Links to real URLs - `?page=3` is a page you can bookmark, share and reload. htmx upgrades them to a partial swap; with JavaScript off they are ordinary navigation.
caveats: Give the container `<nav aria-label="Pagination">` and the current page `aria-current="page"`; without it, every number sounds the same.
Disabled previous/next should be a `<span>`, not a link with `pointer-events: none` - a disabled link is still focusable and still announced as a link.
The numbers need a real hit area on touch: 40px is the floor, which is why they use the control padding rather than being bare text.
